provenance: scripted (manually authored, deliberately flawed to exercise the revision loop)
summary: Expand/backfill/contract where only the NEW application keeps both columns in sync (dual-write on new writes).
write_consistency: New app writes are mirrored to the old column (emulated by a trigger that only reacts when customer_note changes). Old app writes are assumed to be covered by the backfill.

stages.description: Add nullable customer_note and mirror new-app writes into note.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note text NULL
CREATE TRIGGER migproto_note_sync BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION migproto_note_sync()

stages.description: Copy note into customer_note in batches of 100.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE customer_note IS DISTINCT FROM note ORDER BY id LIMIT 100)

stages.description: Roll out the new app next to the old one.
Remove sync machinery and the old column.
sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS migproto_note_sync ON account_user
ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note
